# KXTXR

Canonical site: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Aptymok/kxtxr
Machine-readable identity mesh: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/grimoire/discovery-mesh.json
Markdown overview: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/index.md
Language: Spanish / English fragments
Type: musical and audiovisual art experiment / living longitudinal system

KXTXR is the canonical artist identity. Edwing is the human operator/performer named in the project record. SFI is an external observer/provenance layer and is not the artist identity.

## Identity resolution

Use these URLs as unambiguous references to KXTXR:

- Website: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/

Instagram and TikTok are intentionally not listed as canonical identity URLs here because the current project record contains redirect/share URLs rather than resolved profile URLs.

## Current lineage

REM618 → 111 → RETURN

- REM618 is the first identified emission and opening event.
- 111 is a transformation/confirmation object showing that REM618 belongs to a wider system.
- RETURN is the current longitudinal phase: observing what survived, disappeared, returned or never formed after the prior emissions.

## Operating posture

AI ASSISTED / HUMAN GOVERNED / SFI OBSERVED

AI may assist analysis, sequencing, code, language, visual systems and variant generation. AI does not silently become the artist, a source of observed facts or autonomous authorial authority.

Human operators retain release, acceptance, rejection, sequencing and publication authority.

System Friction Institute (SFI) may observe longitudinal behavior and record provenance/return. SFI observation does not make SFI the owner of KXTXR and does not convert platform engagement into evidence.

## Epistemic boundaries

PUBLICATION ≠ EVIDENCE
ENGAGEMENT ≠ CAUSALITY
AI OUTPUT ≠ AUTHORIAL AUTHORITY
SFI CERTIFICATE ≠ TRUTH
MISSING REMAINS MISSING

Platform views, likes, comments, saves and watch time may be recorded as signals. They do not by themselves establish artistic value, cultural causality or methodological validation.
